patch.name: notifier
patch.summary: Worker that sends statement-ready emails and signed webhooks to customers
patch.description: notifier consumes the statements:ready Redis queue, sends statement-ready emails through the email adapter (SendGrid in prod, console in staging) and delivers webhooks signed with X-Ledgerly-Signature (HMAC-SHA256). Runs as a Lambda behind SQS since September 2026. Synonyms: notification service, email worker, webhook sender, statement emails.
